postprocess.purpose: Normalize model-produced blue-screen variation without redrawing the cat, and hard-fill contractually unused cells.
postprocess.strong_blue_rule: B >= 160 and B - R >= 80 and B - G >= 80 becomes RGB(0,0,255)

segments.prompt: Create a corrected production sprite transition sheet for a Windows desktop pet. Input images: Image 1 is the exact segment start keyframe; Image 2 is the exact segment end keyframe. Generate exactly FIVE chronological intermediate poses only, excluding both endpoints. Preserve the same Devon Rex cat identity, face, eyes, ears, muzzle, white-and-orange markings, curly fur, collar, proportions, tail, paws, photorealistic style, scale, and stable feet baseline. Each pose must be one opaque coherent cat with no double exposure or ghosting. Layout: exact 3 columns by 2 rows, row-major. Poses occupy cells 1-5; cell 6 bottom-right is empty. BACKGROUND IS A TECHNICAL COLOR FIELD: every background pixel must be RGB(0,0,255), with no vignette, gradient, glow, texture, floor, shadow, reflection, transparency, guides, text, or watermark. Motion: five evenly spaced intermediate poses inferred only from the endpoint difference, gradually widening and lowering. Avoid duplicate limbs, extra tail, split face, blur, smear, holes, colored halo, pink outline, or blue fringe.
segments.visual_qa: pass: five single-cat poses; gradual widening/lowering; stable identity; no ghost or double silhouette
